     \[
     \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{600}{1210} \right) \times 100 = 49.59\%
     \]

  - The remaining 49.59% is allocated to other short-term investments, indicating a diversified approach to short-term asset management.

This discrepancy of $120 million should be flagged for further investigation to ensure accuracy in reporting and data integrity.
